scope: Single-file non-author source review and read-only verification of the author's original small unit diagnostic. This does not approve original scale acceptance, a new primary run, or TODO closure.

source_findings.finding: Each &str is tied to the mutable borrow of its own Rows cursor. The two SQLite statements and cursors stay live for the comparison loop. equal_rows, example and append_digest consume the borrowed views before either cursor advances on the next loop. There is no unsafe code, stored borrowed row, changed cursor order, or shared cursor between sides.

The locked rusqlite0.40.1 archive's String FromSql implementation calls ValueRef::as_str then allocates String. Row::get maps InvalidType to InvalidColumnType with column0, actual column name and data type, and maps Utf8Error to Error::Utf8Error with column0. The proposed reader preserves these mappings, index validation and the unchanged Rows::next error path while eliminating only String allocation.

Sorted SQL, duplicate alignment, byte digests, numeric Value equality including signed zero, absent-side behavior, all fifteen tables, three examples,16KiB example omission and all row/scratch/canonical byte limits remain unchanged. Borrowed views are passed to the exact existing equality, example and digest helpers.

The retained cfg(test) owned reader is the original next_row. The complete old compare function is an exact parent copy after only renaming the function and its next_row calls. A machine comparison verified this; it does not call the new borrowed reader. Shared helpers are unchanged by this diff, so no newly changed helper is shared into both sides of the differential control.

The seven complete-report cases cover empty sides, reordered duplicates, mixed SQL values, UTF-8/NUL/escaping, extra rows, mismatches, over16KiB example bodies, and signed-zero truth with distinct raw digests. Complete Value and serialized report bytes are compared against the old loop. Six negative reader cases cover Null,Integer,Real,Blob,invalid UTF-8 Text and a SQLite step error, checking Debug and Display equality. Two warmup plus30 alternating AB/BA pairs retain every outcome and compare complete reports.

test_gap_assessment: No additional blocking case was identified for this narrow allocation/lifetime change. Existing original streaming budget, capacity, duplicate ordering and batching controls remain necessary and were included in the observed nine-test run. This review does not generalize the small synthetic fixture to100k behavior.
